serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Yo Priestbot, long time no see!
Priestbot: Beg your pardon?
You: Uh-h… It’s me, Anon. Have you already forgotten about me?
You: Don’t tell me…{{wi}} Did they format you?
Priestbot: …
Priestbot: You must have confused me with my predecessor in this diocese. Ecclesiasticalot  number 05192018 is still in the Vatican. Due to his high position his free time is limited.
You: Oh, ok. How am I supposed to call you then?
Priestbot: I’m Ecclesiasticalot number 11196290, but you can call me Mark.
You: Mark?! How did you come up with that?
Priestbot Mark: People from my previous church. Sweet and humble folk, they showed me a lot of love.
Yeah, I’m sure they were thrilled about having a talking fridge around...
You: Right…{{wi}} Why leave then?
Priestbot Mark: Orders. I’m here to fill the gap that was created after the ‘incident’ here.
Priestbot Mark: Oh right! You said that your name is Anon, right? Let me check your data in the database.
You: Uhm, ok?
Priestbot Mark: Hm… Weird, there’s not much about you here, I can’t even see a date of your last sacraments. It’s like you never went to church for a few years.
…
Priestbot Mark: What?! Your clearance level about the ‘incident’ is higher than mine?! 
Priestbot Mark: I’m really sorry sir! I didn’t know you were a VIP!
W-wha?? What is he talking about!
You: P-please, I don’t know what you are talking about!
Priestbot Mark: Sir wants to stay secretive about it, I understand, I went overboard!
You: Stop screaming! People will start looking at us!
Priestbot Mark: I-I understand. I’m sorry, sometimes I get too excited. 
You: As long as you understand…
Oh man, he’s a pain to deal with, but in a completely new way. Are all Priestbots so Goddamn annoying?!
You: Is Shanice in town?
Priestbot Mark: You mean High Priestess? No, she’s with my predecessor. 
Well that’s too damn bad. 
Wait, what did he say?{{wi}} High Priestess?
You: What did you call Shanice? High Priestess?
Priestbot Mark: You don’t know?!
Priestbot Mark: Her title is a bit unusual for our organisation, but some exceptions were made to properly reward her for her efforts. I don’t know a lot about it. I was still infected with the virus when these things took place.
Priestbot Mark: Oh, right. That’s supposed to be like a super secret, so please stay silent about it. I don’t want to get in trouble!
You: So why did you tell me about it!
Priestbot Mark: You have a higher clearance! I thought you already knew!
Priestbot Mark: What happened, happened…{{wi}} It’s not like I can make someone’s memories disappear.{{wi}} This function was scrapped after a test trial.
…
Priestbot Mark: Well, it was nice talking with you, but Father Wilhelm’s ankle bracelet monitor is showing him being 50m from the local preschool. Gotta go make sure his will does not break!
You: What?! Shouldn’t he be under watch for 24 hours a day?
Priestbot Mark: He made some progress, ok?! We are all sinners.
You: What progress did he make?! He fapped to milf porn once?!
Priestbot Mark: I get what you are saying, but I really need to go!
